title: Ringed pro-etale open-closed localization
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ a closed immersion with complementary quasi-compact open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $A$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-small-proetale-site], and use $i^{-1}A,j^{-1}A$ on $Z,U$. The inverse images and direct images are those of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], and $j_!$ is the sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] of the extension-by-zero presheaf [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf]: its value at $V\to X$ is the given module evaluated at $V\to U$ if this factorization exists, and is zero otherwise. The localization of sites is [lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization], with their induced module actions [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. The module functor $j_!$ is left adjoint to $j^{-1}$. These functors satisfy $i^{-1}i_*\cong\operatorname{id}$, $j^{-1}j_!\cong\operatorname{id}$, $j^{-1}i_*=0$, and $i^{-1}j_!=0$. The functors $j_!$ and $i_*$ are exact. For every $A$-module sheaf $M$ the counit and unit give a short exact sequence [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] $0\to j_!j^{-1}M\to M\to i_*i^{-1}M\to0$. If $X$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $i_*$ commutes with small filtered colimits of module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit, def-weil-size-convention].
